page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.e-c1m2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 vCPUs and 8 physical cores with 1 thread per core under a shared CPU allocation model. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average performance across several standard workloads. The server achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1729.79 and a multi-core score of 7072.24. Memory bandwidth tests show 570.8 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, dropping to 80.28 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 49.91 GB/sec for large-block writes. However, single-threaded performance is a notable bottleneck, with poor results in single-threaded gzip compression (18.66 GB/sec) and Geekbench single-core testing (859.0). Multi-threaded decompression and image processing also fall into the weaker performance tiers.

Given its shared CPU allocation and lack of local storage, this server is positioned as a budget-friendly option for workloads that do not require sustained, dedicated CPU performance. It is well-suited for tasks like static web serving, where it achieved a throughput of 10.17 GB/sec, Redis operations (9.25 million operations per second), and basic database operations. It is less suitable for CPU-heavy single-threaded tasks or intensive data compression due to its lower single-core benchmark ratings.
